title: Normalized immersion coefficient inverse image is constant-section linear
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, and any immersion g:Y→X of schemes, the coefficient identifications of [def-sf-integral-immersion-pullback-normalization-data] preserve all constant integral sections, all finite quotient projections and all quotient transitions. The ordinary derived inverse image, restricted to sfIntegralConstructibleCategory on X, is linear over O_E for the published constant-section actions. This asserts neither comparison isomorphism, shift compatibility, exactness nor preservation of constructibility.

proof.text: The normalized completed-ring identification intertwines all finite projections. Apply the canonical profinite coefficient inverse-image comparison; its finite constant-ring maps preserve constants and commute with quotient maps. Joint monicity of the completed projections proves the constant-section and projection equations. The adic datum supplies the transition equation.

On generators of module inverse image, multiplication by the constant r is carried to multiplication by the same constant r. Tensor balancing and sheafification extend this equality to module morphisms. Degreewise it holds on complexes; linear localization extends it to all derived morphisms for the published constant-section action. Restrict the source to the full integral constructible subcategory. Empty schemes give the same identities in zero module categories.
